cc:Work.dc:title: temperature schema comparison
cc:Work.dc:description: The old temperature-0.7 prompt is retained as a stress-test baseline. The new temperature-0.1 schema run is the headline experiment: parseability should approach 100%, leaving genuine vote-matrix evaluability as the object of study. E marks an ensemble that the ntqr solve could evaluate.
